narrative.details:
Allow me to admit something, adventurer. While draenethyst is sacred to us, and keeps us sane, none here fully understand it.

I recall a mage who once came to the Harborage, from Desolace. A human by the name of Azore. He feared the power of the draenethyst; said it shouldn't fall into the wrong hands.

At the time, we drove him away to protect what was ours. Lately, however, I find myself wondering what exactly he knew.

I ask that you find this mage, friend. His knowledge could be of immense value to us.
narrative.objectives: Find the mage in Desolace who knows about the power of draenethyst.
